docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Raghuvaṃśa, Kālidāsa’s mahākāvya on the line of Raghu: Dilīpa’s service of the cow Nandinī, the conquests of Raghu, Aja and Indumatī, Daśaratha, the story of Rāma (cantos 10 to 15), and the decline of the dynasty down to the pleasure-loving Agnivarṇa. The Sanskrit text of the nineteen cantos.

From Wikisource · Public domain
